_readme: Round 2 for BLK-TCIP-INTERFACE-FLOOR, 2026-08-07. Round 1 measured, and did not guess, why the Supporting Information of EV-EB-TCIP-2025 (10.1021/jacs.5c05634, PMC12851799) did not arrive: the PMC /articles/instance/.../bin/ path answered HTTP 200 with an 85-character body reading 'Preparing to download ...' (PMC's download interstitial, not the file); the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint answered 'Article with id PMC12851799 is not open access one'; pubs.acs.org answered 403 behind 'Just a moment...'; the /pmc/articles/... path answered 404. So the document exists (the main text names it: NIHMS2124316-supplement-Supporting_Information.pdf, 10.8 MB, 'Supporting Figures 1-11, Chemical Synthesis, Supporting Tables 1-11, RNA-seq dendrograms, and additional references') and four hosts have each refused it for a DIFFERENT and identified reason. These are the remaining routes.
_note_preprint: The cached main text states in its own words that the article 'is based on a previously available preprint posted on bioRxiv on March 17, 2025'. A bioRxiv preprint carries its supplementary material openly, so the preprint is the most likely open route to the same SI content; its DOI is not in the cached text, which is why a bioRxiv search page is fetched rather than a guessed DOI.
_note_tracer: TRACER (Stieger et al., ACS Cent Sci, PMID 42500035, DOI 10.1021/acscentsci.5c02277) is a SECOND chemically-induced transcriptional-proximity modality - it tethers MBD2/NuRD to transcription-factor ligands and reads out transcription. Europe PMC records it as isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, and names its bioRxiv preprint 10.1101/2025.10.22.680877. If its induced interface is also uncharacterised, that is a second independent instance of the same gap rather than one paper's omission.
